rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or above it, or the printed item number on its row. Items 1, 3, 4, 13 and 21 options take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option). Name and address continuation lines join under the item 8/9 captions. Item 7 RDO takes drpPg1Pt1I7RDOCode (txtRDO holds the same code, one cell only). Part II, Part IV, Schedule I, Schedule III, Schedule IV items 1 to 4 and Schedule V amounts are whole-peso combs with no centavo comb, so no money_joins pair exists and each takes a peso_joins entry that prints the amount rounded to whole pesos; Schedule II rows 1-4, Schedule IIIA items 4-7 and the Schedule IV continuation take the printed row order under their column headers (the layout numbers them in the same order). Item 2 Year Ended prints over its four digit boxes and the page 2-4 TIN combs the nine TIN digits (derived: keys of Form1702RTDraft::to_print_field_map); Item 10 and the Part III dates print through date_joins. Stamped TIN combs (name=) take no join. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason.
